mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, a.attachment_name, a.attachment_ext, a.attachment_size, a.status, a.view_count, a.download_count, a.published_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.version
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM cms_article a INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id LEFT JOIN cms_category c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE a.deleted = 0
AND a.status = 2 AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0
AND a.author_id = #{query.authorId}
AND a.status = #{query.status}
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND a.category_id IN
#{categoryId}
AND a.created_at >= #{query.dateFrom}
AND a.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{query.dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY
a.view_count a.download_count a.updated_at a.created_at a.published_at
ASC DESC
, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, a.attachment_name, a.attachment_ext, a.attachment_mime, a.attachment_size, a.status, a.audit_by, auditor.nickname AS auditor_name, a.audit_at, a.audit_remark, a.published_at, a.view_count, a.download_count, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.version FROM cms_article a INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id LEFT JOIN sys_user auditor ON auditor.id = a.audit_by LEFT JOIN cms_category c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0
AND a.status = 2 AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, a.attachment_name, a.attachment_ext, a.attachment_size, a.status, a.view_count, a.download_count, a.published_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.version, COALESCE(r.average_rating, 0.0) AS average_rating, COALESCE(r.rating_count, 0) AS rating_count, COALESCE(f.favorite_count, 0) AS favorite_count, COALESCE(l.review_like_count, 0) AS review_like_count, ( a.view_count + a.download_count * 5 + COALESCE(f.favorite_count, 0) * 10 + COALESCE(r.rating_count, 0) * 8 + COALESCE(l.review_like_count, 0) * 2 ) AS popular_score FROM cms_article a INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id INNER JOIN cms_category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT resource_id, COUNT(*) AS favorite_count FROM cms_resource_favorite GROUP BY resource_id ) f ON f.resource_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT resource_id, COUNT(*) AS rating_count, ROUND(AVG(score), 1) AS average_rating FROM cms_resource_review WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY resource_id ) r ON r.resource_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT resource_id, SUM(like_count) AS review_like_count FROM cms_resource_review WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY resource_id ) l ON l.resource_id = a.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 2
AND COALESCE(r.rating_count, 0) > 0
AND COALESCE(l.review_like_count, 0) > 0
ORDER BY
a.published_at DESC COALESCE(r.average_rating, 0) DESC, COALESCE(r.rating_count, 0) DESC COALESCE(l.review_like_count, 0) DESC
a.view_count + a.download_count * 5 + COALESCE(f.favorite_count, 0) * 10 + COALESCE(r.rating_count, 0) * 8 + COALESCE(l.review_like_count, 0) * 2 DESC
, a.published_at DESC, a.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE cms_article SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND deleted = 0

UPDATE cms_article SET status = 2, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_at = #{now}, published_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND (id, version) IN
(#{item.id}, #{item.version})
